executive_thesis.text: The first recorded mid is 100 and a later recorded mid is 110, a difference of 10; this is descriptive only.

assumptions: The venue quote stays representative of the instrument.
falsifiers: A later eligible mid below the first recorded mid would contradict the drift.
interpretations.text: The samples are consistent with a stable upward drift; this is not a forecast.

assumptions: The recorded rise reflects persistent demand.
falsifiers: The next eligible mid is lower than the latest one.
interpretations.text: A continuation of the recorded rise would extend the move.

assumptions: The rise may be a transient quote artefact.
falsifiers: The mid stays above the first recorded value.
interpretations.text: A reversal below the first recorded mid would invalidate the rise.

key_findings.text: The third eligible mid is 21 percent above the first.

risks.text: Single-venue quotes may not reflect executable liquidity.
